newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thailand eyes international bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Thailand eyes international bond issue.

text.p: The Kingdom of Thailand is taking proposals from investment banks for an international bond issue, syndicate sources said on Monday.
They said the issue probably would be at least US$500 million in size and would set a benchmark for other Thai borrowers.
A Yankee bond is likely, they said.
Thailand's Ministry of Finance last year mandated Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to arrange a US$200 million floating rate note issue for the kingdom.
The issue was later shelved in favor of a government guaranteed FRN for Thailand's Government Housing Bank.
